data.question: How do I place an order?
data.answer: Browse products, add them to your cart, and complete your purchase through checkout.

data.question: Can I cancel my order?
data.answer: Orders can be cancelled before they are shipped. Check order details for cancellation options.

data.question: How can I track my order?
data.answer: Once your order is shipped, you can track it from the Orders section using the tracking ID.

data.question: What payment methods do you accept?
data.answer: We accept UPI, credit cards, debit cards, and Cash on Delivery on selected orders.

data.question: Is online payment safe?
data.answer: Yes, all transactions are encrypted and processed through secure payment gateways.

data.question: Are your products organic or naturally grown?
data.answer: We follow eco-friendly farming practices. Product-specific details are mentioned on each product page.

data.question: How should products be stored?
data.answer: Store products in a cool, dry place as mentioned on the product label.
